description: Turn any short video clip into an animated GIF. Choose clip length, frame rate and width — frames are captured and encoded right in your browser.

faqs.a: GIFs store every frame as an image, so long clips get huge fast. This tool caps clips at 10 seconds, 15 fps and 480 px wide to keep files usable.
faqs.q: Why are there limits on clip length and size?

faqs.a: The animated GIF downloads automatically as a .gif file once encoding finishes. Larger settings take longer to encode.
faqs.q: Where does the GIF go when it is ready?

faqs.a: Yes — the video is read frame-by-frame on your device and the GIF is encoded locally. Nothing is uploaded.

howto: Choose a video file from your device.
Set the clip length (seconds), frame rate and output width.
Click "Convert to GIF" and wait while frames are captured and encoded.
Your animated .gif downloads automatically when it is ready.
title: Video to GIF Converter
